name: 66224 · Leawood, KS
findings: ZIP 66224 (Leawood) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66224 (Leawood) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
